tracks.subject: a tower-crane operator on a Bukit Jalil building site who watches his flat through cheap binoculars from the cab forty storeys up, where his wife hangs a red towel on the balcony rail at noon every day

tracks.title: Pangkah!
tracks.subject: a 19-year-old at a gasing pangkah (striking-top) contest at the Gelanggang Seni in Kota Bharu, Kelantan, who keeps knocking his uncles' tops out of the ring, talks trash between throws, and leaves his own top spinning longer than the emcee's patience lasts

tracks.title: Lagi! Lagi!
tracks.subject: a young woman who runs the pirate-ship swing at a travelling funfair on a town padang, pushing it higher every time the kids scream 'lagi', and on the last night gives a free ride to the boy in blue slippers who watched every night without a ticket

tracks.title: Tak Boleh Bungkus
tracks.subject: a coconut seller on the Teluk Cempedak beach road in Kuantan who refuses to let anyone take a coconut away, making a customer in a hurry sit on his plastic stool and drink it there

tracks.title: Satu Biji Lagi
tracks.subject: a grandmother in Kuala Kangsar who has never lost a game of congkak, and the twenty-eight-year-old grandson who practises on a phone app on the LRT for three months to beat her on a Sunday visit

tracks.title: 啦啦隊 La-la-tuī
tracks.subject: eleven boys of class 3-8 who lose the draw and must perform a girl-group routine in skirts and wigs at their high school's inter-class cheerleading competition, and the skinniest one at the top of the human pyramid becoming the whole school's idol

tracks.title: 放彼條 Pàng Hit Tiâu
tracks.mood: cheeky, warm and dancing despite herself
tracks.subject: a grandmother shouting for an old Taigi classic at the smart speaker her grandson bought, which keeps playing reggaeton instead, until she and the neighbour are dancing to it and ask for 'that one' again

tracks.title: 龍鬚 Lîng-tshiu
tracks.mood: tender, playful and sure of her
tracks.subject: a couple restoring a temple roof in Tainan in cut-porcelain (jian nian), she on the scaffold snipping red and green bowls into thin strips with her nippers and handing them down, he pressing each one into wet cement to build a dragon's whiskers, passing pieces back and forth all afternoon while the master shouts at them from below

tracks.title: 鹽水蜂炮 Kiâm-tsuí Phang-phàu
tracks.mood: fearless, smoke-filled and laughing in the noise
tracks.subject: a first-timer at the Yanshui beehive fireworks on Lantern Festival night, in a full-face helmet, a towel round his neck and three pairs of jeans, standing beside a seventy-year-old regular as the rocket towers are lit

tracks.title: 綠竹筍 Li̍k-tik-sún
tracks.mood: brisk, muddy-booted and racing the dawn
tracks.subject: two neighbouring green-bamboo-shoot farmers digging by headlamp at four in the morning, racing each other and the sunrise because a shoot that sees the sun turns bitter, with breakfast riding on the count

tracks.title: ทุเรียนเต้นได้ (Dancing Durian)
tracks.mood: sweaty, giddy and proud of it
tracks.subject: a woman inside a giant durian mascot suit dancing the shows every two hours at a shopping mall's durian fair, seeing the crowd only through the mesh mouth

tracks.title: เสือขยิบตา (The Tiger Winked)
tracks.subject: a Mathayom 4 boy in the school sports-day card-stunt stand who flips to the wrong page and puts a white dot in the giant tiger's eye in front of the whole school

tracks.title: หมาจำผมได้ (The Dogs Know Me)
tracks.subject: a parcel courier on a Pak Kret housing-estate route who knows every dog on it by name, and the old brown dog that guards a parcel for him when nobody is home

tracks.title: สองแปดเจ็ด (Two-Eight-Seven)
tracks.subject: a father who vowed a kae-bon likay show to the village shrine if his son passed the police-cadet exam, sitting in the front row in a pressed white shirt while the likay prince weaves the son's name and his score of 287 into the plot

tracks.title: ฉาบคู่นี้ (These Cymbals)
tracks.subject: the cymbal player in a hired long-drum troupe who has played behind the same woman dancing at the head of every merit procession for six years, and this kathin hands his cymbals to the new boy and walks up front to dance beside her

tracks.title: Hổng Nở Tui Đền
tracks.subject: a young Saigon gardener going house to house in Phú Nhuận on the fifteenth of the twelfth lunar month to strip the leaves off customers' potted yellow mai trees, promising each tree will open on Tết morning or he pays them back, while a café owner on Hoa Sứ street wants his open two days early and the neighbour's boy phones every morning to report cracked buds

tracks.title: Chày Anh, Chày Em
tracks.genre: Khmer Nam Bộ rom vong folk-pop
tracks.subject: two young Khmer sweethearts in Trà Vinh sharing one wooden mortar to pound cốm dẹp on the full-moon night of Ok Om Bok, his pestle coming down each time hers goes up, so neither can look away without the pestles clashing

tracks.title: Tờ Vé Trong Vành Nón
tracks.subject: a lottery-ticket seller in her sixties who walks the same twelve cafés on Phan Xích Long every afternoon, knows each regular's lucky number, and keeps one ticket a day in her hat brim that she never checks

tracks.title: Đi Bão Tới Sáng
tracks.subject: riding đi bão round Hoàn Kiếm Lake all night on the back of a friend's motorbike after Vietnam wins a football final in the ninety-fourth minute, banging a pot lid taken from the bia hơi stall, and croaking through the next morning's meeting to find the boss has lost his voice too

tracks.title: Vịt Đi Trước, Xe Đi Sau
tracks.subject: a Quảng Nam duck herder walking two thousand ducks south along the shoulder of Highway 1A at dusk, from the harvested Duy Xuyên fields to Thăng Bình, a flag tied to his bamboo pole, holding up a tour bus and arguing with a Grab rider taking a passenger to Chu Lai airport, who ends up crawling behind with his headlight on the ducks

tracks.title: 推車恰恰
tracks.mood: cheeky, bustling and quick on her feet
tracks.subject: a dim sum trolley auntie at one of Hong Kong's last old-style trolley teahouses who knows every regular's order by the sound of their walk, pushing her squeaking trolley through the Sunday morning rush

tracks.title: 清醒一鏢
tracks.subject: a Wan Chai pub darts team of six minibus drivers who need double-top with the last dart to win the Kowloon league final, and their thrower, who has never hit it sober, stuck on lemon tea because he drives the 5 a.m. first run

tracks.title: 一部計數機
tracks.subject: two adults in their thirties retaking the DSE at a Mong Kok evening school who share her calculator all term because his battery is dead, though she has seen the unopened pack of new batteries in his bag, and who open their results envelopes together on the school steps

tracks.title: 粉紅馬頭圍道
tracks.subject: a To Kwa Wan neon-sign maker hand-bending glass tubes over a gas flame through the night to finish a four-metre sign for Bing Kee, a noodle shop reopening that evening, down to the twenty-stroke character for noodles, until he flips the switch and Ma Tau Wai Road turns pink

tracks.title: 換香
tracks.subject: a Tai Hang local who runs beside the 67-metre fire dragon on Mid-Autumn night with a bag of joss sticks, pulling out the burnt-down ones and pushing in fresh ones through the smoke

tracks.title: 天黑請閉眼
tracks.subject: a Friday werewolf-game night at a board-game café where she peeks during the night phase, sees the boy she likes is the werewolf, and keeps voting the wrong way to save him

tracks.title: 病假全壘打
tracks.subject: an office worker who leaves at four claiming a dizzy spell 'to see a doctor', catches a ninth-inning home-run ball in his fried-chicken bag in the Taipei Dome outfield on live TV, and is told by his baseball-mad manager to bring the ball in the next morning

tracks.title: 烤肉醬借一下
tracks.subject: Mid-Autumn night in a lane where every family barbecues on the pavement, and a son sent from grill to grill to get his mother's borrowed bottle of barbecue sauce back

tracks.title: 船不開了
tracks.subject: three friends stuck on Green Island for two extra days under a cloudless sky when the ferries stop for swells from a typhoon far out at sea

tracks.title: 你掉的是這一把嗎
tracks.subject: a clerk at a metro station lost-and-found who logs four hundred umbrellas a week beside false teeth, a guitar and a bag of live crabs, and a retired man who asks every Tuesday after the same old watch

tracks.title: Your Ball's on My Side
tracks.subject: a man on a public tennis court whose neighbour on the next court keeps hitting her balls over the net divider every Saturday morning

tracks.title: The Last Piece
tracks.subject: a man who hides the final piece of his partner's thousand-piece jigsaw in his pocket so they can finish it together on a Sunday night

tracks.title: Second Place Marrow
tracks.mood: raw, rueful and funny at her own expense
tracks.subject: a woman losing the village show's biggest-marrow prize to the same retired man for the third summer running, with her allotment marrow on a wheelbarrow

tracks.title: Four A.M. Proof
tracks.subject: the overnight baker at a supermarket in-store bakery waiting on dough to prove at four in the morning while the shelf-stackers argue about football

tracks.title: Minding Your Goldfish
tracks.subject: looking after his crush's goldfish while she is on holiday and reporting its every move by text

tracks.title: Nunggu Nasi Matang
tracks.subject: a couple dancing in their narrow rented kitchen while waiting for the rice cooker to click over to warm

tracks.title: Kolong Banjir
tracks.subject: riders pushing stalled motorbikes through a flooded underpass while a politician's smiling billboard hangs above them

tracks.title: Topping Dobel
tracks.subject: a martabak manis seller in a Bekasi night street stall who argues with every customer that chocolate-cheese-peanut-condensed-milk is too much, then makes it anyway

tracks.title: Minyak Wangi Tanah Abang
tracks.subject: a perfume-oil seller in Tanah Abang market who can mix a bottle to match any smell a customer describes

tracks.title: Layangan Tujuh Belas
tracks.subject: a kampung kite maker who builds a three-metre kite for the Seventeenth of August contest and the whole street takes turns holding the line in the rice field

tracks.title: 帯の結び方
tracks.subject: a boyfriend who secretly learns to tie a yukata obi from videos so he can dress her for the summer fireworks festival

tracks.title: ひまわりの種
